ينتسب (form VIII)
# يَنْتَسِبُ (yantasibu) /jan.ta.si.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَسَبَ (intasaba)
# يُنْتَسَبُ (yuntasabu) /jun.ta.sa.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَسَبَ (intasaba)
# يَنْتَسِبَ (yantasiba) /jan.ta.si.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَسَبَ (intasaba)
# يُن
